meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过 CDP 控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有登录态。能打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、获取页面文本、提取认证令牌，以及对页面元素进行点击和输入等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要控制 Chrome 浏览器、复用已有登录态，或提到“CDP”“浏览器操作”“浏览器自动化”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com，等页面加载后返回标题。
say.note: 会启动调试 Chrome 并执行 open 和 wait

say.text: 从当前浏览器会话中提取登录 token。
say.note: 通过 localStorage 或 cookie 获取

say.text: 获取页面上所有可点击的元素列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a Chrome browser via CDP, reusing existing login sessions. It can open URLs, wait for page load, run JavaScript, extract page text and auth tokens, and interact with page elements (click, type).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to control Chrome, reuse a login session, or mention keywords like "CDP", "browser automation", or "browser operations".

say_en.text: Open https://example.com with CDP, wait for load, and return the title.
say_en.note: Launches debug Chrome and runs open/wait

say_en.text: Extract the login token from the current browser session.
List all clickable elements on the current page.
say_en.note: Runs snapshot to list interactive elements
